findings.note: Says Milwaukee starts righty Logan Henderson in Game 2 against Rays ace Drew Rasmussen; also says closer Trevor Megill struggled with his command in a shaky ninth during the 3-2 Game 1 win.

Game 2 preview lists projected lineups and says the Rays bullpen is in good shape: closer Bryan Baker, Cam Booser and Tyler Wells are fully rested, and no Game 1 reliever except Matz threw more than 12 pitches.
Says Milwaukee's staff has a 2.03 ERA over nine playoff games, backed by elite defense and high-leverage relievers, but Uribe, Ashby and Megill all pitched in Game 1.
